members.name: checked
members.doc: Whether the Checkbox is checked, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultChecked
members.doc: Whether the Checkbox starts checked, when it controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the Checkbox: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. Without one, a Checkbox in a CheckboxGroup takes the group's size, and any other takes md.

members.name: indeterminate
members.doc: Shows the mixed state. It is separate from checked, and toggling the Checkbox does not clear it.

members.name: name
members.doc: The name a checked Checkbox submits its value under.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the Checkbox required. Left unset, a Checkbox in a CheckboxGroup takes the group's required state.

members.name: value
members.doc: The value a checked Checkbox submits.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the Checkbox invalid. It shows no error text.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Reports the new checked state.
